title: Sesban flower extract as a natural functional ingredient: effects on texture, antioxidant activity, and shelf- life stability of jelly formulation
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, 3,1865-1879
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00227C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sochannet Chheng, Saeid Jafari, Dharmendra Mishra, Kitipong Assatarakul
This study highlights the potential of Sesbania javanica Miq. (Sesban flower) extract (SFE) as a sustainable, plant-based ingredient to enhance the functional and preservation qualities of carrageenan-based jelly.
